list.title: Experiments
list.description: Split traffic between flag variants and measure which one converts better.

empty.title: No experiments yet
empty.description: An experiment splits the users who reach a flag's default across its variants, counts who converts afterwards, and tells you whether the difference is real.

noFiltered.description: Pick another filter to see the rest.

new.title: New experiment
new.description: The experiment is created as a draft. Nothing is served until you start it.

needFlag.title: You need a flag first
needFlag.description: Experiments split the variants of a flag. Create a flag with at least two variants.

design.title: Design
design.description: Flag, environment and key cannot be changed once the experiment exists.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.split: Contexts that reach the flag's default, meaning no targeting rule matched, are split across the variants by the allocation. The same user always sees the same variant.
howItWorks.exposure: An exposure is recorded the first time a user is evaluated. Conversions are sent with the tracking endpoint using the conversion event name.
howItWorks.results: Results compare each variant with the control using a two-proportion z-test and need a minimum sample before they can be called.
howItWorks.docs: The method and its limits are described in <0>{{path}}</0> in the repository.

detail.draftDescription: This experiment is a draft. Start it to split traffic and collect exposures; results appear here and refresh every 30 seconds.

disabled.editStopped: Allocation is locked once the experiment has run
disabled.deleteRunning: Stop the experiment to delete it

allocation.title: Allocation
allocation.description: Share of contexts reaching the flag's default that see each variant.

edit.title: Edit experiment
edit.description: Allocation, control and conversion event can only change while the experiment is a draft.

form.flagHelp: The experiment splits contexts that reach this flag's default.
form.productionTitle: Experiments in production affect real users.
form.productionBody: Nothing changes until you start it, and you will be asked to confirm.
form.keyHelp: Unique in the project. Cannot be changed later.

hypothesis.label: Hypothesis
hypothesis.placeholder: If we show the new payment flow, checkout conversion increases because…

allocation.label: Allocation
allocation.chooseFlag: Choose a flag to split its variants.
allocation.help: Percent of contexts that see each variant. The weights must add up to 100.

control.label: Control variant
control.help: Every other variant is compared with this one.

form.conversionEventHelp: The <0>event</0> name your app sends to the tracking endpoint when a user converts.

problems.needTwoVariants: Give at least two variants a weight above 0.
problems.controlNeedsWeight: The control variant needs a weight above 0.

actions.startBody: <0>{{key}}</0> starts splitting real users in <1></1> right away. Experiments in production affect real users. Allocation, control and conversion event are locked once it runs.
actions.stopBody: Stopping freezes the results and removes the allocation from evaluation. A stopped experiment cannot be restarted.
actions.deleteBody: This removes <0>{{key}}</0> with all its exposures and conversions. This cannot be undone.

snippet.title: Send conversions
snippet.description: Call the tracking endpoint when a user converts. Use the same <0>targetingKey</0> as in the flag evaluation.
snippet.footer: Replace the placeholder with an SDK key of the {{environment}} environment (see <0>API keys</0>). To batch, send an array of up to 100 events in one request. Only the first conversion per subject counts.

verdict.minimumSample: A result needs at least {{exposures}} exposures and {{conversions}} conversions in both the variant and the control.

results.title: Results
results.description: Each variant is compared with the control using a two-proportion z-test. Conversions count once per subject.
results.noExposures: No exposures yet. They appear once contexts reaching the flag's default are evaluated while the experiment is running.

summary.needMoreExposures: Not enough data yet: {{current}} of {{minimum}} minimum exposures per variant.
summary.needMoreConversions: Not enough data yet: {{current}} of {{minimum}} minimum conversions per variant.
summary.variantNotEnough: {{variant}}: not enough data yet ({{exposures}} exposures, {{conversions}} conversions).
